scope: generic detector characterization and recovery; no development-05 geometry evidence was used

stages.assumption: axis-transverse faces may describe a circular opening wall
one connected component is one hole-like profile

stages.selector: unique component vertices projected orthogonal to the requested axis
stages.metric: mean projected center and mean radial distance

stages.failure: components with non-positive radius or insufficient usable normals are skipped

stages.important_limit: no analytic circular edge, cylindrical surface, opening identity, through-state, or physical-hole grouping is established

stages.historical_behavior: callers filtered candidates by confidence and expected diameter, then used the result for PASS/FAIL and count
stages.corrected_behavior: candidate observations remain diagnostics; candidate-only machine verification is unverifiable

detector_contract.known_false_positive_cause: The projected radial summary treats near-square, ellipse, polygon, and irregular curved profiles as circular enough. A connected mesh component is also not a physical-hole identity, so multiple bands of one stepped hole become multiple candidates.

production_callers.historical_use: candidate diameter/count and ray probe could directly produce PASS/FAIL
production_callers.current_use: candidate evidence only; returns UNVERIFIABLE without authoritative B-Rep feature evidence

production_callers.historical_use: candidate centers/count/pitch could directly produce PASS/FAIL
candidate diameter and a mesh depth proxy could directly produce PASS/FAIL
production_callers.current_use: candidate evidence only; depth remains unavailable for authoritative verification

production_callers.historical_use: high-confidence candidate median could be verified/violated

production_callers.current_use: UNVERIFIABLE candidate findings; physical_feature_count remains null

production_callers.historical_use: candidate geometry could directly satisfy functional findings
production_callers.current_use: blocking UNVERIFIABLE findings until authoritative feature evidence exists
candidate-only findings are UNVERIFIABLE; asymmetric explicit ray probing remains a separate path

synthetic_shape_matrix.physical_intent: candidate diameter near an arbitrary requirement tolerance
one stepped physical hole with two circular bands
one countersunk physical hole with three bands
one physical feature with three cylindrical bands
rounded exterior profile, not a hole
circular feature with no legal region selector

failed_cases: clean circular candidate alone incorrectly returned passed
near-square candidate incorrectly returned failed instead of remaining unverifiable
red_reproductions.interpretation: The RED assertions demonstrate that the old semantic path treated the same candidate mechanism as authoritative for both positive and negative decisions.

radial_cv.observations: clean circle was approximately 0 while the near-square rounded control was approximately 0.005; the projected vertex sampling hides straight-edge behavior

convex_hull_perimeter_area_circularity.result: useful characterization but not selected as a production threshold

shape_characterization.conclusion: A threshold could separate the chosen controls only with a shape-classification policy that would need broader evidence and still would not establish physical-hole identity or distinguish an interior opening from an exterior curved wall.

stl_authority_assessment.decision: downgrade STL detector to candidate evidence
stl_authority_assessment.reason: The detector is useful for coarse discovery and diagnostics, but the tested mesh evidence cannot defensibly establish physical-hole identity, circular analytic geometry, through-state, or grouping of stepped-hole bands. Candidate-only PASS/FAIL is therefore unsafe.

b_rep_availability_audit.current_topology_evidence: topology-evidence-v2 exposes valid shape, solid count, volume, shells/faces, bounds, centroids, and solid relationships
b_rep_availability_audit.decision: No broad B-Rep hole verifier was implemented in this checkpoint. A future B-Rep-backed neutral feature contract is required before authoritative circular-hole machine PASS.

physical_feature_identity_analysis.evidence: two- and three-band synthetic representations of one stepped/counterbored/countersunk physical hole produce two or three raw candidates
physical_feature_identity_analysis.grouping_status: not deterministically available from the current detector
physical_feature_identity_analysis.prohibited_workaround: Do not select only candidates matching the expected diameter to manufacture physical identity or count.

diagnostic_correction.user_meaning: Candidate observations cannot by themselves support a statement that the CAD contains the requested physical holes.

before_after.raw_candidate_extraction: unchanged; true circular and false-positive profiles remain observable candidates
before_after.candidate_only_semantic_paths_before: could return PASS or FAIL from candidate count/diameter/center/depth
before_after.candidate_only_semantic_paths_after: UNVERIFIABLE with measurement_available=false and derived_stl_candidate evidence
before_after.false_pass_prevention: candidate-only evidence cannot produce authoritative PASS

regression_audit.changed_historical_expectations: candidate-authoritative hole PASS/FAIL assertions changed to intentional fail-closed UNVERIFIABLE; one complete-source workflow fixture no longer declares the unsupported candidate-only mounting-hole requirement
regression_audit.classification: intended fail-closed downgrade; no unintended regression identified

checks: no project IDs in production behavior or synthetic tests
no development-05 source, dimensions, or artifact used
no requirement weakening or UNKNOWN-to-PASS conversion

operations.synthetic_geometry_scope: 19 matrix cases plus 2 semantic candidate-authority gates

product_path_audit.requirement_ledger: count, diameter, scope, and revision identity remain contract fields; no hidden mesh convention was added
product_path_audit.validation: candidate evidence is surfaced as candidate evidence, while authoritative pass/fail waits for stronger geometry evidence
product_path_audit.diagnostics: raw and matching candidate observations are distinguishable from verified physical-feature count
product_path_audit.revision: a future revision can target the stable requirement identity without depending on detector internals
product_path_audit.manufacturing_boundary: no printer, build-volume, splitting, or other manufacturing concepts introduced

recommended_next_action: Address physical candidate identity/grouping as a separate generic evidence problem, or document the required B-Rep-backed neutral feature contract before any authoritative circular-hole verifier is added. Keep feature-profile production work parked unless new independent evidence changes its NO-GO.
